content.text: Login Page Specification
Intent
This spec defines the requirements for a minimal Login Page that authenticates clients of "jikol" via a username and password.
Requirements
User Interface
The page must contain a "Username" text input field.
The page must contain a "Password" masked input field.
The page must contain a "Login" button.
Error messages must be displayed if authentication fails.
Functional Requirements
When the user clicks "Login", the system must validate the credentials against the "jikol" authentication service.
Upon successful login, the user must be redirected to the dashboard.
Upon failed login, the page must display "Invalid username or password" and remain on the login page.
Security
Passwords must be transmitted over HTTPS.
The password field must mask input (e.g., using `type="password"`).
Open Questions
What is the specific URL or endpoint for the "jikol" authentication service?
Is there a "Forgot Password" flow required for this version?
Are there specific branding or styling guidelines (CSS/UI framework) to follow?
Should there be a "Remember Me" checkbox?

comments.text: Upon failed login, the page must display "Invalid username or password" and remain on the login page.
The specification lacks a rate-limiting or lockout policy. Recommend defining a maximum number of failed attempts to prevent brute-force attacks.
When the user clicks "Login", the system must validate the credentials
The functional requirements do not specify behavior for empty fields. Suggest adding client-side validation to prevent requests when the username or password fields are blank.
